description:
PROCESS-ENTER-KEY's ordered EVALUATE TRUE at app/cbl/COUSR01C.cbl:117-151, arm two. The commarea arrives with CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT 1, so NOT CDEMO-PGM-REENTER at :83 is false, MAIN-PARA takes the ELSE at :88-89, receives the map at :201-209 and evaluates EIBAID at :90-103; DFHENTER selects :91-92 and PROCESS-ENTER-KEY runs. FNAMEI carries NEWTON so arm one at :118-123 cannot match, and LNAMEI is twenty spaces, which equals the SPACES figurative constant, so :124-129 is the first WHEN that matches and the EVALUATE stops there: WS-MESSAGE receives 'Last Name can NOT be empty...' and MOVE -1 TO LNAMEL positions the cursor, which is how COBOL positions one. The arm moves 'Y' into WS-ERR-FLG, so IF NOT ERR-FLG-ON at :153 is false, the five MOVEs at :154-158 never build SEC-USER-DATA and WRITE-USER-SEC-FILE at :159 is never performed - which is why expectedWrites is empty and USRSEC is left exactly as seeded, the positive form of the assertion that nothing was written. The three later arms at :130-147 stay unreachable in this case however blank their fields are, and that ordering is the whole of the contract: an EVALUATE is ordered and the first match wins. The five screen fields go back out carrying exactly what was received, because INITIALIZE-ALL-FIELDS at :287-295 is reached only from the NORMAL arm of the write at :252 and from CLEAR-CURRENT-SCREEN at :281.

The send. SEND-USRADD-SCREEN at :184-196 is performed once, and the run then ends at :107-110 by EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID rather than by XCTL. Its payload is the twelve xxxO items of app/cpy-bms/COUSR01.CPY: TRNNAMEO X(4), TITLE01O X(40), CURDATEO X(8), PGMNAMEO X(8), TITLE02O X(40), CURTIMEO X(8), FNAMEO X(20), LNAMEO X(20), USERIDO X(8) - USERIDO on this screen, not the USRIDINO of COUSR02 and COUSR03 - PASSWDO X(8), USRTYPEO X(1) and ERRMSGO X(78). The paired xxxL, xxxF and xxxA items are length, flag and attribute metadata rather than payload fields, which is why the cursor is stated as the length-item name LNAMEL. MOVE WS-MESSAGE TO ERRMSGO at :188 narrows PIC X(80) into PIC X(78) truncating on the right, so the two message channels differ by exactly their last two bytes and are compared as two different things. ERRMSGC carries DFHDFCOL because MOVE DFHGREEN TO ERRMSGC at :254 is the only attribute assignment anywhere in this program and this path never reaches it; the field's own COLOR=RED at app/bms/COUSR01.bms:151-154 is the map's declaration, not something the program assigns.

USRSEC is seeded from app/jcl/DUSRSECJ.jcl:35-44, whose ten in-stream rows are 57 characters where app/cpy/CSUSR01Y.cpy declares 80: SEC-USR-ID X(08) at 0, SEC-USR-FNAME X(20) at 8, SEC-USR-LNAME X(20) at 28, SEC-USR-PWD X(08) at 48, SEC-USR-TYPE X(01) at 56 - which is 57 - then SEC-USR-FILLER X(23) at 57, which is 80. The 23-byte shortfall is supplied once at seed time by the declared USRSEC_FILLER_PAD_57_TO_80 normalisation and is never hand-padded here, and the 80-character expectedFinalState images are what prove that span was emitted as 23 spaces: a record missing it would be short by exactly 23. The same job corroborates the target width twice, with DCB=(LRECL=80,RECFM=FB) on SYSUT2 at :48 and RECORDSIZE(80,80) KEYS(8,0) on the cluster at :64-66. The dataset is addressed by its binding key USRSEC - the CICS file name at :39 - and never by a dataset name, which lives in application.yml. The FINAL_STATE dataset expectation states the count as well as the bytes, ten rows of 80: that is the assertion that no eleventh row appeared, which ten row images by themselves cannot make.

Determinism. POPULATE-HEADER-INFO opens with MOVE FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE TO WS-CURDATE-DATA at :216, so the clock is pinned rather than read: 2022-07-19T23:12:34, traceable to this program's own version footer at :298, and expressed as a fixed local date-time so no timezone can shift it. Through app/cpy/CSDAT01Y.cpy, WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY is MM '/' DD '/' YY with YY taken from WS-CURDATE-YEAR(3:2) at :225, giving CURDATEO exactly 07/19/22; WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS is HH ':' MM ':' SS, giving CURTIMEO exactly 23:12:34 at the PIC X(8) COUSR01 declares - the sibling COSGN00 map declares its CURTIMEO PIC X(9) and the two must not be conflated. The code page is named explicitly as US-ASCII rather than left to a platform default. TITLE01O and TITLE02O are CCDA-TITLE01 and CCDA-TITLE02 of app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy byte for byte, TRNNAMEO is WS-TRANID 'CU01' at :37 and PGMNAMEO is WS-PGMNAME 'COUSR01C' at :36 - both consistent with app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD:459-460, which defines TRANSACTION(CU01) PROGRAM(COUSR01C).

Three properties of the legacy design are asserted rather than assumed. COPY DFHATTR. at :57 is commented out, so no DFHATTR constant is compiled into COUSR01C at all and no expectation here may name one; DFHAID and DFHBMSCA at :55-56 are live but IBM-supplied and absent from this repository, so their mnemonics come from common.CicsAid and common.BmsAttributes. COUSR01C copies neither CSSETATY nor CSSTRPFY - both grep to zero - so this screen has no '*' error marker and no per-field DFHRED, and EIBAID is tested inline at :90-103 rather than through YYYY-STORE-PFKEY. And SEC-USR-PWD stays plaintext: :157 moves PASSWDI straight into it and app/cbl/COSGN00C.cbl compares it as typed, so hashing would change behaviour and is an explicit non-goal; the seed value is the 2022-vintage demo password already present in this repository as in-stream JCL data and it guards nothing.

Where the neighbouring paths live, since this case deliberately reaches none of them. The two that transfer instead of sending are case19, the EIBCALEN = 0 guard at :78-80 which XCTLs to COSGN00C, and case16, WHEN DFHPF3 at :93-95 - the key common.PfKeyResolver resolves to PFK03 - which moves 'COADM01C' into CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM and XCTLs to the admin menu, per TRANSACTION(CA00) PROGRAM(COADM01C) at app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD:327-328 and the 43-byte footer literal 'ENTER=Add User  F3=Back  F4=Clear  F12=Exit' at app/bms/COUSR01.bms:155-159. Both run RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN at :165-178, which stamps CDEMO-FROM-TRANID 'CU01' at :170 and CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM 'COUSR01C' at :171, echoes CDEMO-USER-ID and CDEMO-USER-TYPE back exactly as supplied because :172-173 are commented out, zeroes CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT at :174 and then transfers - so the EXEC CICS RETURN at :107 is never reached on either. Their shared guard at :167, IF CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM = LOW-VALUES OR SPACES, is unreachable from both callers, because :79 and :94 each assign a program name immediately before performing the paragraph; it is preserved as dead defensive code rather than tidied away, and no case in this folder fabricates a path that reaches it. This case takes none of that route: it returns at :107-110 with the context still 1, so the next invocation re-enters and validates again. The blank-field arm it does pin is the second of the five, and the five are pinned in source order by case02 through case06.

Provenance. Every expected value above is statically derived - by structured reading of app/cbl/COUSR01C.cbl:83-89, :90-92, :117-151 and specifically :124-129, then :153-160, :184-196 and :214-233, with :93-95 and :165-178 read for the transferring paths this case contrasts with - cross-checked against app/cpy/CSUSR01Y.cpy for the record's byte layout, app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy for the sixteen commarea fields, their widths and their 88-levels, app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy and app/cpy/CSDAT01Y.cpy for the literals and the header, app/cpy-bms/COUSR01.CPY with app/bms/COUSR01.bms for the screen field shapes, app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD for the CU01 and CA00 bindings, and app/jcl/DUSRSECJ.jcl:35-44 for the ten seed rows. It was never captured from a live COBOL execution, which is empirically impossible in this environment: there is no z/OS or CICS runtime, the available compiler reports its indexed file handler disabled, no Language Environment CEE* services exist, and DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR are absent from the repository. Only the provenance of the expected values is substituted; the twenty cases, the field-for-field diffing and the diff-count-equals-zero gate all stand. It is stated in the case rather than left to a commit message because a statically derived expectation can encode a misreading of the COBOL where a captured one cannot, and whoever debugs a failure needs to know which side to doubt.

The unit is user.UserAddController, constructed through its own constructor as a plain Java object with a fixture-backed user.SecUserRepository injected and MAIN-PARA called directly - no MockMvc, no test REST template, no servlet container and no JobLauncher anywhere in the path, because a parity assertion about byte layout is only obscured by a dispatcher, a filter chain and a JSON round trip. All conversation state - the commarea, the attention identifier and the screen values - travels in the payload, so no server-side session holds any of it. jobParameters is present and empty because CU01 is a CICS transaction with no JCL and no PARM. expectedReturnCode is 0: this program has no CALL 'CEE3ABD' and never moves to RETURN-CODE, and both grep to zero. Neither the numeric-parity gate nor the backward-GO TO gate applies - COUSR01C contains no COMPUTE, ADD, SUBTRACT or ROUNDED, and no GO TO at all - and neither is faked.
